steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 47
steps.text: In this C2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I finally got used to waking up early.
I always procrastinate on Sunday nights.
Sorry, I'm running late because of the traffic.

steps.title: Gramática: Comparatives and Superlatives
steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "Comparatives and Superlatives"?
options: He told me he would call later.
This is the most expensive restaurant in town.
She will call you if she has time.

steps.title: Idiom: Cost an arm and a leg
steps.text: It means: "To be very expensive.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: That car cost an arm and a leg.
